entries.title: Land of the Vikings
entries.definitive_edition: Land of the Vikings on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Land of the Vikings is a PC/Windows release on Steam and GOG, with no console or Mac/Linux release found. The Windows PC version is therefore the only platform and the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release on Steam or GOG.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release available through Steam and GOG.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no platform split; Windows PC is the complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster, definitive edition, or platform-exclusive content exists.
